name: xyOps
description: xyOps is a self-hosted operations automation platform for job scheduling, visual workflows, server monitoring, alerting, tickets, and incident response.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent xyOps database and file storage.

paths.name: Configuration
paths.description: Persistent xyOps configuration, including config.json, overrides.json, masters.json, and the generated secret key.

paths.name: Logs
paths.description: Persistent xyOps logs and startup hostname tracking.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Allows xyOps to launch and manage containers for the Docker Plugin and Plugin Marketplace.

ports.name: HTTP Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the xyOps web UI, API, and default satellite communication.

ports.name: HTTPS Port
ports.description: Built-in HTTPS/TLS port for the xyOps web UI. xyOps ships with a snakeoil certificate, so generate and configure a real certificate before relying on this for production.

variables.name: Conductor Hostname
variables.description: Stable hostname xyOps uses as its conductor identity. Change this to a DNS name reachable by xyOps workers and job containers.

variables.name: Conductor Masters
variables.description: Comma-separated conductor hostnames. For a single Unraid install, keep this the same as Conductor Hostname.

variables.name: Base App URL
variables.description: User-facing URL used in email links, tickets, alerts, and web hooks. Set this to the address people use to open xyOps.

variables.name: Local xySat
variables.description: Starts a local xySat worker inside the conductor container for home labs and first-run testing.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used for daily log rotation and statistics resets.

variables.name: Node Max Memory
variables.description: Maximum Node.js old-space heap size in MB for the xyOps conductor process.
